{{Quote|What can I say? My survival mechanism just kicked in. I run on instinct. Can't control it. I want to be brave, but something happens, and I open my mouth and a womp weasel starts talking. Nothing personal.|Swanny Mull|<ref name="TST">''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]''</ref>}}
The '''womp weasel''' was a creature. The [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Swanny Mull]] once referred to himself as a womp weasel after he denied knowing [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in order to avoid getting into trouble.<ref name="TST" />

Womp weasels could be kept as pets. They were found in at least three varieties, Black, Brown, and White.<ref name="TOR" />

They could become infected with disease.<ref name="TOR" />
